# PDF to Markdown
> Free local-first PDF ↔ Markdown / Word converter. Files never leave the browser — PDFs are parsed client-side with pdf.js, with no server upload. Built for LLM, RAG, Obsidian, Notion, and ChatGPT workflows. Available in 9 languages.

## Core Tools
- [PDF to Markdown](https://pdftomarkdown.run/en): Free, private, in-browser PDF to Markdown converter — the main tool
- [PDF to Word](https://pdftomarkdown.run/en/pdf-to-word): Convert PDF to editable Word (.docx) entirely in the browser
- [Markdown to PDF](https://pdftomarkdown.run/en/markdown-to-pdf): Convert Markdown documents back to PDF locally
- [Scanned PDF to Markdown](https://pdftomarkdown.run/en/scanned-pdf-to-markdown): OCR scanned PDFs into Markdown without uploading files
- [PDF to Markdown with Images](https://pdftomarkdown.run/en/pdf-to-markdown-with-images): Convert PDFs to Markdown while keeping embedded images
- [Batch PDF to Markdown](https://pdftomarkdown.run/en/batch-pdf-to-markdown): Convert multiple PDFs to Markdown in one local batch
- [PDF Table to Markdown](https://pdftomarkdown.run/en/pdf-table-to-markdown): Extract PDF tables as GitHub-flavored Markdown tables

## Use-Case Guides
- [PDF to Markdown for Obsidian](https://pdftomarkdown.run/en/pdf-to-markdown-for-obsidian): Convert PDFs into vault-ready Markdown notes for Obsidian
- [PDF to Markdown for Notion](https://pdftomarkdown.run/en/pdf-to-markdown-for-notion): Prepare PDF content for import into Notion
- [PDF to Markdown for ChatGPT](https://pdftomarkdown.run/en/pdf-to-markdown-for-chatgpt): Turn PDFs into clean Markdown for ChatGPT, LLM, and RAG workflows
- [PDF to Markdown in Python](https://pdftomarkdown.run/en/pdf-to-markdown-python): Compare Python libraries with this browser-based converter
- [Best PDF to Markdown Converter](https://pdftomarkdown.run/en/best-pdf-to-markdown-converter): Compare this local tool with CloudConvert, Pandoc, and similar converters
